adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument. But `refreshOAuthTokens` is defined as `(refreshFunction, appSlug, userId)` and, in sync mode, sends it as `calcomUserId` (`userId.toString()`) to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`. Other services in the diff consistently pass `credential.userId`, so this would map refreshed tokens to the wrong user when credential sync is enabled.
